what: Sources cited by the three English articles that research/english_sources_check.py does not cover: pages that only render in a browser, and sources outside the Bybit help center. Each was opened on 2026-11-22 and the listed facts were read on the page.
method: Browser for the pages marked browser (a plain HTTP request to them is redirected to the home page, returns an empty body, or shows a PDF viewer). Plain HTTP request for the rest. Numbers in the articles were not changed from the research files of 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19; this file only records whether the English page exists and agrees.

differences_between_english_pages_and_re: Introduction-to-Funding-Rate: the page was updated on 2026-11-19 (both languages) and now announces a new formula from 2026-11-24. The Chinese article of 2026-11-18 cites the page as updated 2026-06-05 and does not mention the change.

Introduction-to-Funding-Rate also says the premium index history can be viewed under Contract Details. The Chinese article says Bybit does not publish the per-settlement premium index; the English article says only that the weighted average was not rebuilt from that history.

Help-center last-updated dates differ by language for Funding-fee-calculation (en 2026-05-12, zh-TW 2026-04-27), Introduction-to-Bybit-Card-Rewards and FAQ-Bybit-Card-Rewards (en 2026-11-08, zh-TW 2026-10-30). No number read from them differs.
FAQ-Bybit-Card-General-Inquiries marks Apple Pay as not supported for the Asia Pacific card; the owner's statement of 2026-11-18 records a payment made with Apple Pay.
